result:
I found 12 rules whose code didn't match their docstrings and fixed all of them in `pricebook.py`. I then checked all 150 rules against a reference built from each docstring and the module's shared rules. It covered quantities 0–259 at 10 different unit prices, and no rule disagreed.

| Rule | What was wrong | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 02, 105, 138 | Marked "whole" but only discounted units above the threshold | Discount now applies to the full price (`base * pct // 100`) |
| 09 | Threshold was 21 | Changed to 20 |
| 79 | Threshold was 13 | Changed to 12 |
| 107 | Threshold was 6 | Changed to 5 |
| 55 | Took 9% off | Changed to 8% |
| 48, 108, 142 | Rounded the discount (`round`) | Now rounds down to the won (`//`), as the shared rules require |
| 63 | Capped the discount only when it went over 20,000 won | Now always capped at 10,000 won |
| 89 | Capped the price before taking the percentage | Now takes the percentage first, then caps the discount |

STATUS: DONE
